title.title: NCT 24hr RELAY CAM
title.overview: NCT 24hr RELAY CAM is a web show starring members of SM Entertainment's NCT. It consists of the members from sub-units NCT 127, NCT DREAM, NCT U and WAYV showing a specific time of their day, which is decided in the first episode.

episodes.overview: This episodes consists of the members from sub-units NCT 127, NCT DREAM, NCT U and WAYV showing a specific time of their day, which is decided in the first episode, getting their time assignment and challenging one another to games to get better time slots.

episodes.name: JAEMIN : 11AM-12PM
episodes.overview: Jaemin starts the relay vlog by showing NCTzen special items, and how he edits images.

episodes.name: MARK : 12-1PM
episodes.overview: Mark wakes up to take over the relay cam, and he and Jungwoo visits for lunch and to spend the day together.

episodes.name: JUNGWOO : 1-2PM
episodes.overview: Jungwoo takes over the relay and spends the hour with Mark.

episodes.name: TEN : 2-4PM
episodes.overview: Ten takes over the relay and shows life in the dormitory with the cats, Louis and Leon.

episodes.name: LUCAS : 4-5PM
episodes.overview: Lucas takes over the relay cam to have lunch and show NCTzens spots around Seoul.

episodes.name: JISUNG : 5-6PM
episodes.overview: Jisung takes over the relay camera and does his physiotherapy whilst discussing life with NCTzens.

episodes.name: KUN : 6-7PM
episodes.overview: Kun begins his relay hour in the recording studio, making songs and musical beats . Lucas briefly visits whilst waiting to record.

episodes.name: YUTA : 7-8PM
episodes.overview: Yuta starts his hour on the relay cam and draws whilst talking about some of his favourite movies.

episodes.name: JAEHYUN : 8-9PM
episodes.overview: Jaehyun takes over the relay cam and tells us about shows he's been watching.

episodes.name: CHENLE : 9-10PM
episodes.overview: Chenle starts his hour on the relay cam, and DJs for TBS Radio.

episodes.name: SUNGCHAN : 10-11PM
episodes.overview: Sungchan makes customised shoes for his hour of the relay cam.

episodes.name: SHOTARO : 11PM-12AM
episodes.overview: Shotaro tales over the relay cam to record and showcase his dance practice. Sungchan joins him to help him learn the '90s Love's dance.

episodes.name: HENDERY : 12-1AM
episodes.overview: Hendery begins his relay by gaming with friends; Lucas visits to check in on him, and games with him. He ends the relay by practicing origami.

episodes.name: RENJUN : 1-2AM
episodes.overview: Renjun does a room tour, showcases his art and creates some art with Jisung and Jeno.

episodes.name: HAECHAN : 2-3AM
episodes.overview: Haechan gives a short room tour, fills Zens in with what he has been doing in recent weeks, and chats with NCTzens on social media.

episodes.name: JENO : 3-4AM
episodes.overview: Jeno continues the relay with a room tour and items that are special to him. He also plays some video games to pass the time.

episodes.name: XIAOJUN : 4-5AM
episodes.overview: Xiaojun starts his hour of the relay cam by cleaning out the dog litter box, making food, showing NCTzens how to make a simple Oreo cake, and singing for the viewers.

episodes.name: WINWIN : 5-6AM
episodes.overview: Winwin wakes up to take control of the relay cam. He shows his morning routine, shows some of his games and crafts off, and watches television.

episodes.name: YANGYANG : 6-7AM
episodes.overview: Yangyang takes viewers to the store for breakfast, cooks and eats, and talks with viewers about what's happening in his life.

episodes.name: TAEIL : 7-8AM
episodes.overview: Taeil fills viewers in with what he has been doing and wants to do in 2021, plays 'Pre Evolution Soccer' with Jungwoo and reminiscences on things that happened in 2020.

episodes.name: DOYOUNG : 8-9AM
episodes.overview: Doyoung wakes up to take over relay cam; he has breakfast, and chats with NCTzens about his plans and favourite foods.

episodes.name: JOHNNY : 9-10AM
episodes.overview: Johnny goes to the salon and gets his hair dyed for his hour of the relay camera.

episodes.name: TAEYONG : 10-11AM
episodes.overview: Taeyong ends the relay cam by waking up and going to set for recording.

similar.title: CHANNEL AOA
similar.overview: The show will provide AOA with the chance to create videos on whatever interests them, battling each other in order to earn the most amount of views. The reality program will show the process behind how the girls went about making their videos.

similar.title: Changing Majors
similar.overview: Changing Majors is a South Korean variety web series featuring various universities, colleges and schools, and the courses offered inside. The series starred Lee Chang-sub of BtoB for the first five seasons, and Kai of Exo beginning season 6.
